newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ to host international young designer awards.
newsitem.headline: NZ to host international young designer awards.

text.p: New Zealand is to host the inaugural international Young Designer of the Year Awards in the South Island city of Christchurch in August.
The awards aim to encourage the development of design skills in teenagers to prepare them for the needs of industry in the 21st century, organisers said on Monday.
"Quality is about design," said Cathy Baker, director general of the Young Designer Charitable Trust which runs the awards.
"These awards recognise the wealth of creativity our young people have to offer and seek to demonstrate the importance of their skills to the highly competitive industries of the future."

School students between the ages of 13 and 19 are asked to develop design projects in a range of categories including communication (advertising, packaging and print media), the built environment (architecture and interior design), industry and product (consumer and electronic products and furniture), and fashion.
The awards will be judged by a group of international designers from the United Kingdom and New Zealand.
Baker said more than 30 countries had expressed interest in participating, with confirmed entries to date from South Africa, the UK, Malaysia, Singapore and Australia.
